description: CSV formula injection corpus (issue #725, spec 12.3 and 16.3 g). 'text' cells that start (after any whitespace) with = + - @, or start with TAB or CR, must be written with a leading apostrophe; 'safe' text is written unchanged. Numbers are typed values and never guarded (checked in the test).
